findings_and_reconciliations.classification: Conditional source-only test-harness lifecycle concern, extending explicit historical observation; no runtime witness or product defect.
findings_and_reconciliations.trace: withDeadline races an already-started operation against a rejecting timer and clears only the timer. The cold initialization await includes chromium.launchServer; the browserServer variable is assigned only after that promise resolves. The outer failure path eventually tries to kill only the currently assigned browserServer, and catches close/kill errors.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: If launchServer resolves after the cold deadline and after finally has observed browserServer as undefined, its late continuation may own a browser process that the prior cleanup did not kill. Whether a real launch can reach that ordering, what external timeout/process supervisor does, and process termination outcome are unobserved. A timeout is not itself evidence a process survives.
findings_and_reconciliations.future_repair_direction: For later harness work, bind cancellation and owned process cleanup to the full asynchronous lifetime, including late launch resolution and timeout/error cases; retain diagnostic deadline and bounded cleanup without asserting new product readiness.
relationships: 059 segovb READ-L11-400 already observed Promise.race does not cancel and does not prove renderer termination; READ-L11-401 separately recorded launchServer cleanup. This adds a specific late-assignment condition, not a new historical discovery.

findings_and_reconciliations.classification: Source-defined test-mode compatibility gap; intended mode policy and runtime reachability remain open.
findings_and_reconciliations.trace: Canonical map readiness requires state.covered, a requested city and a ready city installation. In non-real mode the provided WebAssembly status stub returns covered:false and omits city_requested. Regional view publishes its parsed native status as metrics.mapState. The test selects canonical map readiness for STRATEGIC_TRAVEL_PLACE=map but its visible startup precondition only requires captures for STRATEGIC_TRAVEL_BENCHMARK.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: With the stub actually installed, the map predicate selected and no external instrumentation replacing the state, the predicate cannot be satisfied from that stub. The intended benchmark may be restricted to real renderer; this source does not establish that the combination is supported or was attempted.
findings_and_reconciliations.future_repair_direction: Document or enforce supported mode combinations; if mock map readiness is intended, make its contract model the required status fields without using it as proof of native GPU, environment or city behavior.
relationships: 059 READ-L11-401 explicitly distinguishes mock bridge, hardware and conditional benchmark branches; this narrows their mode interaction and does not infer runtime acceptance. Prior regional map and scene sources remain independently attributed.

findings_and_reconciliations.classification: Conditional test-oracle gap, not established missing production metrics or a passing run.
findings_and_reconciliations.trace: The no-new-generation assertion compares optional window.strategicGenerationMetrics?.scene snapshots. If both are undefined, equality alone cannot establish that generation did not occur. The ordinary scene coordinator creates and publishes a fresh owner metric when its preparation starts, so absent instrumentation is not presumed on that path.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: The concern requires metrics to be absent in both snapshots, or for actual generation not to be reflected by the compared metrics. Whether either condition can arise in supported ready states has not been established; screenshots, timing, cache and generation behavior were not observed.
findings_and_reconciliations.future_repair_direction: Specify the intended instrumentation lifetime and require its presence and authoritative generation identity/count before treating equal snapshots as proof; distinguish reused jobs, optional cache, canceled generation and true new preparation.
relationships: Related to prior /root/hair_ops optional cache failure question and q1899 address/cache/receipt chain, but not an automatic alias. Prior scene readiness q556 remains a separate command acknowledgment boundary.

Source/place/origin/scale in fixture route are test native identities. Prior scene packet establishes different exact string presentation vs numeric tactical identity; mock small numeric IDs do not disprove u64 precision.

Deadline races observation without cancellation; cleanup and late assignment have the stated lifecycle risk. Quantity or viewport constants in fixture are test parameters, not proof of native invariant violation.
Deadline, viewport, pixels and timing values are test-native measurement parameters; sources justify different boundaries but do not prove chosen thresholds reflect product policy.

Timeout and console patterns are diagnostics; mutable browser error prose and fixture strings are not durable gameplay owners. Older 059 already noted mojibake fixture text; no production rendering claim.
